# DEPLOY by Build Fast with AI

> Forward-deployed AI engineers embed directly with your team to take one high-impact business workflow from POC to a deployed production AI system in 4-6 weeks with full code ownership.

DEPLOY is the forward-deployed AI engineering service from Build Fast with AI (Intellify Edventures Pvt. Ltd.). We bridge the gap between AI prototypes and production-grade software by embedding specialized engineers into your team, codebase, and infrastructure.

## Core Services

- **Forward-Deployed AI Engineering**: Embedded AI engineers working directly inside your Git repositories, cloud environment (AWS, GCP, Azure, or on-premise), and communication channels (Slack, Teams).
- **AI POC to Production**: Fixed-scope 4-6 week sprint taking a single workflow from evaluation baseline to live deployment.
- **Enterprise Agentic Systems**: Autonomous AI agents with deterministic tool use, permission harnesses, and human-in-the-loop escalation.
- **Text-to-SQL & Analytics**: Semantic business layers and RAG systems over operational relational databases reaching ~95% benchmark accuracy.
- **Real-Time Voice AI**: Sub-second latency voice interviewers and copilots with sandboxed code execution and explainable evaluation.
- **Agentic Learning Systems**: Adaptive EdTech AI architectures covering learner diagnostics, teacher copilots, and safe autonomy levels.

## The 4-6 Week Build Methodology

1. **Week 1: Scoping and baseline metrics**: Embed with the team, define security boundaries, agree on target accuracy metrics, and provision repository access.
2. **Weeks 2-3: Build against live production data**: Engineer agent harnesses, retrieval pipelines, evaluations, and API integrations directly against real data and edge cases.
3. **Weeks 4-5: Deploy to production environment**: Deploy alongside existing operations in shadow or live mode to validate real operational lift.
4. **Week 6: Team training and full handover**: Transfer full code ownership, test suites, architecture documentation, and runbooks to your internal team.

## Pre-Built Modular Infrastructure

We assemble builds using proven, tested components:
- **AI Agents**: Autonomous multi-step planning, tool use, and retries.
- **Agent Harness**: Scoped runtime permissions, sandbox isolation, and execution traces.
- **Skills**: Version-controlled capabilities (e.g. document extraction, SQL generation, ticket triage).
- **RAG & Knowledge Layer**: Chunking, reranking, and citation engine with role-based access control.
- **MCP Connectors**: Standard Model Context Protocol integrations for databases, CRM, ERP, and ticketing.
- **Evaluation Suite**: Automated golden test sets measuring regression and accuracy on model updates.
- **Observability**: Complete telemetry for latency, token costs, tool calls, and error traces.
